themes.label: Trade execution lag and failed orders
themes.summary: Users across Android and iOS and many app versions report that orders are slow to register, sometimes cancel when prices tick up, or fail to execute during fast-moving or peak market periods, which costs them money. Several reviewers also say reliability has worsened in recent versions, and some mention the app going down mid-trading-day. Reviewers who use the app for long-term investing are generally satisfied, but the complaints centre on time-sensitive trading.
themes.recommendation: Pull order latency and rejection logs by platform and app version for the past 12 months, focusing on market-open and high-volatility windows, and set a ticket to fix the top causes of slow or cancelled orders with an SLA-based alert on order acknowledgement time.

themes.label: Account lockouts and unresponsive support
themes.summary: Users report their accounts being frozen, locked, or closed for verification or suspicious activity, often with money inside, and then face weeks or months without replies from support. Many say emails go unanswered, phone waits are very long, and agents hand them off to a vague "back office" with no timeline. Some also describe unexplained withdrawals or deposits that never appeared, making the lack of a clear escalation path the main source of anger.
themes.recommendation: Audit support ticket and call-back data for accounts flagged as frozen or locked over the past 12 months, and set an SLA with a named owner that guarantees a first response and a status update within a fixed number of business days, with an escalation path for accounts holding customer funds.

themes.label: Deposit holds delaying trading access
themes.summary: Users report deposits sitting unavailable for three to seven days or longer, with some funds showing as withdrawn from their bank but not appearing in the account, and then a further waitlist or settlement delay before they can trade or withdraw. Many also say support gave vague timelines or could not help, and several cite missed buying opportunities as a direct result. Android and iOS users both raise this, spanning versions from 2020 to 2026.
themes.recommendation: Audit the deposit settlement pipeline by logging timestamps from bank debit, funds-received, hold-applied, and tradable-status events for a sample of accounts, then publish an in-app estimated availability time and a clear explanation of which hold applies to each transfer type.

themes.label: Crashes and freezes after updates
themes.summary: Users across iOS and Android report the app crashing, freezing, going blank, or failing to open right after new releases, sometimes unable to log in or place trades. Several say each update makes things worse and that bugs persist for weeks without a fix, with some noting the app is bloated and slow to load.
themes.recommendation: Pull crash and ANR reports segmented by app version (v2.198.0 through v2.245.0) and OS version, and set a release gate that blocks rollout when crash-free sessions drop below baseline on iOS and Android, starting with the order page and login flows.

themes.label: Login failures and session loops
themes.summary: Users across iOS and Android report being unable to log in, including endless spinner or retry loops, passwords rejected despite being correct, the keyboard not appearing on the password field, and sessions that log out repeatedly even with biometrics or PIN enabled. Several say the problem began after specific app updates (versions 2.199 to 2.238 are mentioned in recent reviews), and many describe being stuck with no working recovery path such as delayed 2FA emails or customer support that never responds.
themes.recommendation: Pull crash, auth-timeout, and keyboard-input telemetry for the login and password screens segmented by app version and OS, starting with the builds named in recent reviews (2.221.0 to 2.238.0), and ship a fix for the password field keyboard failure and the retry loop as a priority hotfix.

themes.label: Hidden USD conversion fees on trades
themes.summary: Users across Android and iOS say Wealthsimple charges around 1.5% or more each time they buy and sell US stocks, because they cannot hold USD and must convert back and forth, and the exchange rate spread between buy and sell prices makes the true cost feel hidden. Many describe the 'no commission' claim as misleading, and some say the total cost reaches several percent of the investment. A few mention the monthly USD account fee as the only way to avoid conversions, which they see as another charge.
themes.recommendation: Audit the USD/CAD conversion path for buys and sells, measure the effective spread versus the mid-market rate on sample trades, and surface the all-in cost (conversion fee plus spread) in the order confirmation screen before the user submits.

themes.label: Recent UI redesign hides holdings info
themes.summary: Users across iOS and Android say recent updates made the app harder to navigate, with holdings prices, percentage returns, and watchlists now buried behind extra taps or dropdowns. Several ask for the prior layout back, and some note that the new screens split holdings across pages and reset list view modes. Many reviewers also say they are considering leaving for competitors.
themes.recommendation: Run a usability audit of the Invest and Holdings screens against the pre-redesign flow, measuring taps to see holding price, daily change, and total return, and ship a fix that surfaces these on the first screen with a settings toggle to restore the earlier layout.

themes.label: Praise: simple, intuitive app design
themes.summary: Most reviews in this cluster praise how easy and intuitive the app is for investing and managing money in one place, with many calling it the best or simplest option for beginners. The lower-rated reviews are mixed, though, and cover crypto spreads and fees, slow deposits, a cluttered interface with too many notifications and in-app ads, and bugs such as a broken daily investment chart. The cluster groups mainly on shared "simple" and "easy" wording rather than one shared problem.
themes.recommendation: Add granular controls in settings to turn off non-essential notifications and in-app promotions, and track how often this request appears in reviews as a ticket to prioritize, while protecting the core simple onboarding and navigation that drives the praise.

themes.label: Mostly praise for banking app
themes.summary: This cluster is dominated by users praising Wealthsimple as an easy, feature-rich, fee-free banking and investing app, with frequent mentions of zero monthly fees and a clean interface. A minority of reviews, mostly older ones from 2020 to 2021 and a 2024 to 2025 review, describe slow or stuck deposits, failed transfers and withdrawals, and unresponsive support. Recent negative reviews also mention delayed credit and bank card shipments and a gambling-style feature.
themes.recommendation: Praise: protect the core experience by monitoring transfer and withdrawal success rates by app version (especially v2.178.0 onward) so that the fund-movement reliability complaints do not grow beneath the positive sentiment.

reviews.t: Please Bring Back the Previous All Holdings View
reviews.x: The latest update has made reviewing and managing my portfolio much less convenient. Previously, the All Holdings view worked as a regular, persistent page. I could open an individual stock, review its details, and then tap Back to return directly to my All Holdings list and continue reviewing the next position. After the latest update, All Holdings is displayed as a floating overlay/sheet. When I open a holding from this view and then tap Back, I am returned to the Home page instead of the All Holdings list. As a result, I have to reopen All Holdings every single time I want to check another position. For users with multiple holdings who regularly review their portfolio one stock at a time, this adds unnecessary steps and makes the experience significantly less efficient. Please consider restoring the previous persistent/full-page All Holdings view. At the very least, the Back button should return users to the All Holdings list they came from and preserve their position in that list. This feels like a significant step backward in usability. The previous navigation was much more efficient and intuitive.

After two hours of waiting for a response, an automated recording suggested checking the website for answers, and the call disconnected. Something wrong is happening to my money, and I have no way to verify what is going on or prevent it!

I'm done with wealthsimple. I'm taking my ball and going home. This app has become confusing, costly, underhanded, and develops bugs at the worst possible moments.Is it really necessary to attach the fee to the price of the asset? This shows that I paid a per share price which never existed, and now I have to wait until the asset gains X dollars before I see any ROI. I'm in the red after every single buy and sometimes catching up is impossible. Trading Crypto is useless here. Uninstalled. C-ya.

Had issues with my bank depositing money. Wealth simple would return money after bank rejected, but they auto sold all my stock, crypto, hit me with a negative, and blocked my access to my account, so I can no longer log in. I cannot rate 5 star, as I use Quest and Interactive, and have never had such issues. Wealth can be great, and it has its benefits, but cannot recommend it over the other brokerages.

I was invited to open an account for a $25 reward for myself and the person who invited me. When I follow their link and try to set up an account on the app it doesn't let me press "next" after entering my email and password. Must be a glitch in the app, and without using the app neither of us are able to claim the reward. Please fix this!

Good investment service, but the app has a lot to be desired. Functionality is way too simplistic and lacks basic expectations. For example, no widgets to monitor investments, dividends, and wishlist stock monitoring, no alerts/notifications, etc. One would figure that an investment firm would provide investment tool for clients, but no so as far as the app is concerned.

There should be an easier way to see the holdings and portfolio weights in the Trade section. Also, the securities search function is clunky, sorting stocks alphabetically makes no sense. Otherwise, I love the functionality and the freedom it gives to manage your own money in a simple and broad way.

I love the cash account and physical card, as well as the investing accounts. The only things holding me back from completely ditching the big banks is the lack of cheques (coming sooner than later I hope), joint cash accounts (or at least the ability to open more than one cash account), and a HYSA that doesn't require investments for liquidity reasons. Hopefully some of these are in the works or at least being considered!

The latest update on the app has made buying/selling more difficult and a lot easier to make mistakes. Cannot see third decimal points on the buying/selling page (example: it will show .275 on a stocks page, then round up to .28 on the buying/selling page). The option to see the amount of bids versus asks was also taken away in the last update. The new buying/selling format in general is a downgrade. It would be nice to have an option in the settings to go back to the previous version.

reviews.t: Do Not Use This App anything else is better
reviews.x: The ONLY upside is how user friendly it is for beginners but have fun trying to do anything when they hold your stock for 5 business days without you being able to sell. Literally stuck not being able to send my btc even tho the bank cleared the deposit. Use any other crypto app and you’ll be way happier.

Wealthsimple does not work as it should. Beware! Do not make trades based on the average stock price in your account info. On several occasions, it has been wrong. I called and they updated my account which changed the average cost of my shares...but it was still wrong. I had purchased a stock on 3 separate occasions at between 6.91 and 6.82.....and it shows my average cost at 5.91. Way off...and they don't know how to fix it after 90 minutes on the phone.

Really good app, lacks core features for options such as buy/sell order at market price, take profit and stop loss. There should be a way to see the realized profit on an option trade when looking at our trade history. Would be great to see the price of the underlying too! Hopefully options also become available ton the desktop web app one day! Otherwise, excellent app!

Literally cannot even get the app past the spinning icon after login. Installed, reinstalled, cleared cache, rebooted Android Samsung Galaxy S10 and still nothing. Spin, spin, spin ... Guess I won't open an account then. Horrible experience. Why can't I do this in a browser, how do you not have a PC version of your bank accounts? If you are going to force the use of a smartphone maybe make sure the app actually works!

My mom made an account with this app and actually made some money. But when she went to withdraw it they have done nothing but run in circles and put her in debt due to them dodging phone calls and emails. In short they stole her money and won’t give it back. If your looking for an actual way to invest DO NOT use this app!!! They will scam and dodge you so you give up and they keep they money.

It's okay, it does most of what it says it does but there are some serious hang ups. I deposited enough cash to qualify for a private credit account but no matter how many hoops I jumped through it was never opened. Perpetually pending. Strictly as a TFSA investment platform its okay, there's a lack of clarity that I think could be addressed, especially in profit/loss. It would be nice to be able to see total equity gains through valuation and divided/reinvested growth, separately vs stacked.

I love this broker. No trade fees! The option I didn't like is recurring investment, and I've turned off. I thought it would buy a stock on price I've set. Instead, it's buying a fraction of the stock. Another thing I wish it had more security options besides text messages or just authentication app. It doesn't feel safe for me to hold large amounts of cash. Maybe I'm just freaking out, but there has been such a large number of scams recently, especially with taxes...

Overall I like the app for its accessibility for newcomers, but the lack of information about the stocks is annoying. When I compare you guys to an app like robinhood where they will tell you the different stocks in the ETFs and their fees. I wish you guys did the same thing. Update: Love the dividend reinvent option but I wish you could select for specific stocks. Instead of all or none of them.
Good app for begging, but Recently they increased fees and Also stealing money while trading or selling.

App used to be good. Now it's really buggy. Takes several minutes to get to the search section or the accounts section. I often have to refresh the app, otherwise it freezes. EDIT: I have to delete the app and re-download it to have a better performance. Also, would be great if we could trade multiple options at the same time. For example, I want to do an option strangle. I will need to buy a put OTM and a call OTM. However, I have to manually buy them 1 by 1.

Would give 5 star, but since recent update, it has gotten very slow, and takes minutes to open up and track as before it took seconds. I do use the cash, investing CAD/USD, tax free savings, crypto, and first home savings. They offer great programs, cash back and alot of investing options... it's just gotten very slow, so you have to dedicate 30+ minutes yo do what is normally a 2-3 minute procedure on any other platform.. once they fix the speed issue. It will be a 5 star app.

I started using this app to trade options. Purchased a large amount of put options, was charged 200 usd on purchase- they gave me CALL options. Went to go instantly resell the options, and the app would NOT fill my order. The app then cut off service, and my stock crashed $2 in less than 40 minutes like I anticipated. By the time I was able to have my order filled I lost close to $2000 usd rather than profit. Please do not use this app EVER. they only fill orders that LOSE money. They sold me the wrong options on MULTIPLE occasions

I found the app useful, but the latest update to the activity list now makes it so the pending transactions are mixed in with the completed transactions. It was better before where pending transactions were listed at the top so I could easily see which ones were still outstanding and I could cancel or change them. Now I have to scroll through the whole list and look for them one at a time. This becomes troublesome if a transaction has been pending for several weeks.

I haven't been able to get into the app from logging in once yet. I enter my credentials and sit at a waiting screen until it asks me to enter my credentials again.. The only way I've been able to get in so far is to follow the links from the emails. I wish we could do more from their website and didn't have to rely fully on the app.

I don’t like my cash account being part of the same chart as my investment accounts if it’s not changed back or if we don’t have an option to separate them I will be moving all my investments over. Super annoying. I’ve been using this app for years and this update is the worst they ever had

You’ll never know where your money actually is to see because every 2 weeks they change the freaking UI. Cash is a separate app, just kidding its now cluttering the main app but surprise not where it was last week oooo we moved it again. Just really poorly designed and they keep changing things just so they can push a new update instead of because it’s better

I have loved the app for the last few years, and it's great that they have been expanding services. Recent issues for the past month are that when I log in, it can take several minutes for the app to open. I have updated the app and phone. The wifi is great. Just ongoing issues. It just took 2m48sec to log in, and I closed the app and reloaded it, and it's still thinking 3 minutes plus now. Frustrating

Ok, for a casual stock investor or robo investor... But crypto trading is terrible. Bad exchange rate and the fee just changed to 2.5% even though it is advertised as 1.5 to 2 percent. They will say it's the 15 min delay, but it's not and started after I updated the app. It's not the first time in my experience they have changed the crypto fees after updating. Stick with Crypto limit orders to reduce fee inflation.

App works fine. Feature Request: Manually logging in every time (like on the old app) is a hassle, but it's a security risk to be always logged in. Give us a setting to automatically log us out and forget our account. Update: App still doesn't log you out for security (despite having the setting, it doesn't work), and as of the last update is so painfully slow as to be completely unusable.

The app is great except this huge security bug. I access it through an old tablet that doesn't have a lock screen set up. I tried turning off quick access but there is no option to do it. I chose quick access 'none' but instead of turning it off it just never locks the device out. If I forget to sign out then it is just ALWAYS signed in... All it needs to fix this is a way to disable quick access.

This application is nice. However their is some minimal issues with this app. Like when changing the name of your account. It bugs put that option were it disappear or not allowing to click it. Also what happened to an option about saving account? I did like the idea of saving money for a spaciffic purchase. I think they removed that option. *if your reading this developer. Please add it back.*

(EDIT: 3 years later this is still a terrible interface with no graphing options no labels on graphs) Terrible interface management. No filtering options, cant set default views for graphs, no way to use this app in any meaningful way other than using some external search engine and hoping the stock you're interested in is actually available for purchase within the app.

I like everything but the how the app deals with the drop down sorting of neither the accounts nor individual funds. - sorting is BROKEN. Ranking stocks in an account by amt gained sorts alphabetically - no option to sort stocks by percentage gain For such an obviously math centered app, this is a glaring flaw. But integration of bank accounts to transfer funds in, and all aspects of stock search are just fine.

I have been using this app for over 3 years now and honestly it has made incredible changes since the beginning. The app itself has gone from mediocre to in my opinion a top contender. At first it only gave you the option of stock trade and crypto. But now 3 years later it has almost everything that even the most novice of traders have a fighting chance. It also offers a cash account with high returns. Note dev team: did not get the 1% cash back on the first purchase i made with the card.

It's detrimental. App with zero functionality, crypto prices are not accurate vs market price, can't trade crypto directly and can't instantly take out funds, held for 5 business days. Fees not transparent. Here is an example from 30 Aug 2023: Price of BTC (in CAD) is 37,104, while on this app it's 37,002.. Buuut the selling price is 36, 274!!! Insane difference. I've never seen such outrageous fees!! A loss (for the user) of almost a 1000 CAD just from price differential. Uninstall, now!!!
I have an older iPhone 6 Plus and this version (2.1) crashes as soon as I try to open the app. The previous version is fine. Please fix and update.
I can’t use a decimal point when making alerts for stock prices now. Updated the app and my iphone is updated so idk whats wrong. Plz fix asap

overall easy to use and intuitive. account set up was quick. free trading. fees based on total amount in account. not all stock funds are available (specifically some US stock funds). new stock funds take time to be available. DRIP recently added, but is activated to an entire account rather than stock specific, this can be time saving for some (set and forget) but offers less control for other users. I personally don't mind. I would recommend WS for new investors especially.

Unreliable. Says that I have immediate access to deposits, but that's a lie. I made a deposit well under the limit but 5 days later still nothing in the account (quick to withdraw from my bank account though). Also setup auto-invest paycheck feature, but of course that didn't work either. Should rename the app to WealthComplicated. I don't want to have to log in every day just to make sure it's doing what it's supposed to.

Good luck actually connecting with any sort of support. You'd think that would be pretty important for a company handling your money. Callback is absolutely useless. They make 0 attempts to call and then have the gall to send emails saying they tried. Holds regularly take up to an hour, regardless of what time you're calling in at. Emails stop receiving replies completely randomly. Looking into issues takes weeks without any sort of response.

Sneaky app trying to trick people into agreeing to the new stock lending scheme. The pop-up interrupts right after you log in and the only way to get past is to click on "agree", but in really small print it also says "restart the app to bypass". I wonder how many users were tricked into agreeing when they thought they were just dismissing the pop-up. You guys should be better than this.
App as been slow since the recent update plus it overheats. My old iPhone XS is working the app fine but my iPhone 14 pro max is having issues.
Virtually every time I login the app pesters me with a new add to lend stocks. There should be a feature to disable this. Not interested in lending stocks.

Unreliable/disrecpectful customer support. They literally stole money from my RRSP without authorization to pay for some services i have never requested. For over five months they ignored my support requests about this matter. I ended up having to escalate it to the OSBI to get my money back. Wealthsimple complaints department NEVER contacted me and support agents are incompetents/clueless. Many customers report not being able to get basic support with Wealthsimple. THINK TWICE before choosing them.
This app is so slow. Always freezes on me. I’ve reinstalled, updated, etc., but it still doesn’t work properly. Could be so much better if it moved as fast as I do.

reviews.t: Make so you can see progress on entire portfolio
reviews.x: Great app. One thing I would change that used to be a thing would be to make it so you can see your ENTIRE portfolios daily profits.
Prepare to wait for a very long even for the basic requests

reviews.t: Please Add A Black Icon Option?
reviews.x: Wealthsimple was better when Cash was a standalone app. Since WS Cash is the only product I use, it was much cleaner and more enjoyable to manage my Cash account. Plus, it just felt right having an app called ‘Cash’ with a white on black icon on my homescreen. Now, after the merge with Wealthsimple Trade, my entire cash experience has been reduced to a single tab in the menu bar of this Wealthsimple app. tldr; I miss the standalone apps.

The app is simple to use and great!! My only issue though is that it doesn't lock immediately after you leave it, which leaves your assets vulnerable if someone were to get your phone within that time. An option that allows you to lock immediately after exiting would be very comforting and much needed. Until then, I give the app 2 stars as it's a major issue.

I have been regularly using the app and after the recent update I noticed the orders are not updating as I placed them. I have to go to the home page and refresh it to see the orders updated. As it is time consuming and sometimes I make quick decisions to cancel the order or change it but I can’t because I can’t even see the orders without refreshing the entire account. It has been creating lots of problems please try to bring back the older version The one which has an update button option.

Compared to the old “gold” Wealthsimple app, this new one has reduced functionality and is very confusing to navigate. It seems that Wealthsimple is popping out new products every day and they don’t know how to organize it all. One example, I cannot figure out how to change my auto-deposit settings from within the app. I don’t think it’s even possible!
Can’t view my portfolio or activity. Just hangs with error messages. C’mon.

This could pretty easily be so much more user-friendly. After las update I don't even see any scale on any of the price charts, so I can see how prices went over time, but can't see by how much, which is the entire point of trading/investing. I can't see for the life of me, how removing the numbers on the charts was seen as a step forward.

The performance graph is next to useless/unreadable if you make regular deposits. Some more details, some lines (like an actual graph) would be great. Most of all: a setting that allows me to see the graph independent of my deposits. I understand the app is meant to be 'simple', but the graph showing portfolio performance takes that a bit too far.
Your new uodate has issues my stocks not loading.

I really like the simplicity and ease of use it would be nice if stock that pay dividends would be labeled as such it doesn't need to show the percentage although that would be nice I just want to know what stock have it and which ones don't. Update: after using the app for a while and after having significant issues moving, converting and withdrawing funds customer service has not been able to help and no one responds to my complaint. I'm out nearly $400 while it sits for weeks as unavailable.

I really like Wealthsimple as a company, and this app has been pretty good for most of its life, but with the most recent update, the application crashes instantly as soon as I open it on my old iPhone 6. I realize it’s a old phone, but you claim it’s compatible; make it so! Also, reviewing the list of transactions for the cash card doesn’t work great. Reversed transactions just disappear, and history past a couple weeks seems unstable and unpredictable. Also, there’s no way to sort things by category, which is a must if I’d use it for my main card.

Edit: alot has improved on the past three years. Less crashes, website is now up, more stock choices now and finally, we got options but they are expensive. No fee part is good. But it's super slow, glitches often, sometimes give wildly wrong accoubt totals. Too slow in processing your orders. When the market crashed during covid, this app literally froze and so i just watched my money disappear cause i couldnt sell. Also, i cant access my account on a website, only the app.

This is a great app and they've made good progress on it. It would be 5 stars if they had an easier way to see properly weighted returns. Currently you have to navigate through multiple menus to see a time or money weighted return % and it's only available in specific accounts. It would also be nice if the default buy type could be set so I didn't have to go through multiple screens to limit buy. For the price though it is stellar. Probably 4.5 stars if I was allowed half stars.

reviews.t: New app is missing an essential feature
reviews.x: Let me start by saying this is a review of this app and not Wealthsimple as a service itself which is great. I recently migrated over from the wealthsimple invest app which tracked my TFSA. When I looked at a graph of my account, it would show me the actual account value, but it also included a little gray line that showed my net deposits. That little line was a really useful metric to show how I was really doing (especially after the really turbulent start to last year when I lost a little bit of money). I’d like to see that feature re-installed and if it returns I’ll certainly change my rating.

Not worth putting your money on too plus the fact if you where to sell something it takes them a long time just to get this done for example you could sell a stock by Monday and it will show that's its pending still and by the time you go to get your money back that stock could be taking a hit a losing its price there for making you lose out on More money then your already trying to take out or get back that's a huge RipOff Plus No Communication From them Whatsoever especially by Email.

Been using this app over a year lots of improvements have happened. Being able to hold most things within one application makes it easier for me personally. Still room to grow definitely when it comes to crypto and staking. As a dividend investor one thing that would come in handy would be able to see how much dividends have been accumulated over time. Options trading is currently on beta testing I'd like to see the option to trade covered calls on both usa and Canadian securities.
Fix the lag in this app. Every update, it’s even worst. This app runs like garbage most times

reviews.t: Merged apps without merging the functionality
reviews.x: They merged the invest app in the trade app but doesn’t carry 90% of the functionality. It redirect to poorly made web view every time. It shows how long they will support your investment.
Now the app stutters a lot and is a lot slower than it used to be. Where is the buttery smooth UI?

App works, but customer service is TERRIBLE!!! Plus when you sell your stock, they hold your funds for three days which prevents you from trading unless you have additional money available aside from the last sale. Get better customer service reps that don't end chat when they haven't even addressed your question, and get phone reps that can actually assist with customer issues rather than deferring it constantly to another department.

The App is laggy, awful to use, and tries to do too much. It seems to just get to you to open wealthsimple in a browser for everything? The old invest app was straight forward and had a simple UI. It was easy to see what was invested and when. Now that info is hard to find and possibly doesn’t exist on the App The way all the apps have been combined creates an overly complex UI. It’s not user friendly. And painfully slow.

reviews.t: Major downgrade from original Invest app
reviews.x: I don’t write reviews but this app drives me to insanity. Anyone who was a user of the original Invest app knows this unified version is missing so many fundamentally basic things. It’s frustrating! Where is the remaining contribution room for registered accounts? Where is the activity log for all of my accounts, and not just Trade? Where is the nice graph showing you net deposits versus balance over time? If you happen to find them, it’s because the app pops you into a web view which loads the mobile website. It’s horrible to use. If I wanted the web view I’d just delete the app and log in via Safari! For that reason I keep the old Invest app around but they keep pushing me to delete it, even to the point where the old app reports balances incorrectly. Super low blow, Wealthsimple! Fix your app!

I really like this app. It does a lot of things that beginner investors (like myself) can do to save money. It's not overly complex like a lot of trading platforms because it's not trying to solely be a trading platform. I've used WealthSimple for my taxes, it offers great savings portfolios, and a TFSA. I think they're also beginning to move into debit cards but I'm unsure of that. It offers a lot of a simple things that traditional banks often miss out on.

Logged in, confirmed 2-step, enabled biometrics, but, I’m met with an endless loading screen. Tried uninstalling reinstalling, tried rebooting phone, tried turning off VPN, nothing. iPhone SE 2020 iOS 15.4.1.

Great investing app! Simple, cheap, useful. Amazing for Canadian investments, with socially responsible investment and crypto options too. Highly recommend. Only downsides are 1) a limited selection of securities, especially outside North America, and 2) their promotions and rewards are a scam, I haven't had one work in 2 years of using them. They'd be better off just not running them - its honestly just bad advertising.

Low fees if there are any, works as expected in every way. Not for day trading but good for buying and holding. It also doesn't support stock exchanges in other countries which I would like. Recent changes combinding the trade and invest apps lowered my rating to three stars. The combined app is missing a bunch of features the other apps had. For example, being able to delete an account, easily looking up all deposit history (it seems to only provide me an arbitrary "recent" set)

It works pretty well. Can be a bit laggy at times. My biggest issue is that it times out WAY too soon. If I'm checking realtime stock movements on another app on my phone, it will time out and ask me to login again after less than 15 seconds of being away. A real PITA. Please fix this, or make it an adjustable setting.

I wish I could give a negative rating. I signed for USD plus and they messed up everything. I lost almost 1000$ for not being able to access my funds, couldn't sell or buy US stocks at a crucial time when the market was crashing. I have been talking to customer support for a week now and this lady today said that my order settlement will happen 2 days after and I don't even know what that means. I thought the app will be user-friendly but since I signed up for USD plus, they froze my assets.

The app works fine, with the exception that they always highball all of the stock values when you buy them. Often times 5% more than what you can actually buy it for if you put a limit on the buy. The customer support is also useless, I have had a pending issues for over two months now. (Where they stole money from me by over inflating a stocks value during a stock split <$300 they litterally just pocketed>) If you want an investment app that will steal your money this is the app for you!
Watchlist goes empty ramdomly need to be fixed
I did e transfer before 1 day and still doesn’t show in my account, I called them and was long waiting time.

An app that gives you only the minimum. It would be great if the app went straight to the login screen and using your fingerprint to login is great but not when it also asks for your password, authenticator and pattern. The support link just goes to the website rather than allowing you to send a note from the app. Their method of showing returns is deceitful, showing simple return, the worst measure. And so many other options and information are withheld. Simple yes but should be better.

it would not be difficult to add some of the most basic functions that a trading platform should have (Fibonacci, etc.) Graphs are not accurate when compared to other platforms using the same time frame (24hr, 7d, wk, 1mo, 3mo etc.) People would find more success on this platform with increased accuracy, and a couple quick tools. very easy to add, even on the mobile platform. This is coming from someone who works in the tech world.

This has given me the worst banking experience. I am trying to withdraw my money for over week. First time it asked for verification. Then I called customer care. They gave me a long set of forms to fillup, which I did and submitted. After several days, they said problem solved, but when I tried again same issue came and worst. Then my account was suspended. I called them again. They asked to upload more documents. After another day they said problem solved. When I tried to log in it is same.

The unified app experience really lacks user customization. It’s a utility app, not a marketing landing page. I don’t understand why there are tabs and sections that are completely irrelevant to the services I have. If you want to up-sell products, do it clearly through marketing and clear description labels. Not by misleading UI patterns that get you to buy stocks while opening a new account at the same time. It’s irresponsible and confusing to users who might not understand the implications of what they’re doing. The previous app designs were also much more elegant and cleaner.

They removed the net deposits comparison line when you long-press the time series graph. It does me no good to see the value of my investments went up $480, without also showing me that it's due to my $500 deposit that month. Seems intentional and shady.

The new app makes it harder to focus on what I want as there is a pile of stuff there that I am not interested in, and I can’t hide or reorder items in the UI so that I can focus on what does interest me. Very frustrating. I am not going to add Wealthsimple’s other products so this app design just makes me feel like they are just are forcing me to think about all that stuff every time, which is really irritating. This just makes me more likely not to open this app, as the cognitive load involved has just increased massively. Given how much money I’m giving them, I’m feeling pretty unappreciated.

Trying this app today (Oct 31/22) as the prompted by the INVEST app. Sadly, the valuable reference point of total deposits is missing from the investment graph viewer. I hope this is a temporary oversight, and I will continue using the Invest App until this is corrected.

I wish they integrate an advance version just imitate the webull app for canadians. I like webull but I cannot use it in canada. They have the tools. It's cool to have all the advanced stuff in my phone. Wealthsimple can keep it like this for beginner but there should be a button to switch to advance interface where we have all the tools.

Cost basis is wrong, even after an associate looked into it and "fixed" the issue. How can my cost basis not be accurate? How is it that I bought a stock at a price I never had before? Just another broker doing broker things. Won't be surprised if they restrict my ability to trade when the market is volatile. Will transfer everything out as soon as possible, will direct register in my name and move to smart contract wallets asap.

Holds your cash hostage for a ridiculous amount of time after every transaction. It's constantly out of sync, like each page is showing some different, not yet updated, values. I can't even uninstall it because I have to wait before they will let me withdraw MY cash. Do not trust this company, this is a scam.

BEWARE! After using it for few years, I understand you get exactly what you pay for with this company! The 'forward-thinking' is charging you top percentage dollar per year for automatically splitting your cash to put into bunch of ETFs. You're charged fees and double fees all over while they claim 'Oh zero fee', you have to deal with insane amount of hoops to access your funds and deal with endless bugs with the app. Lot of features are missing in the websites to force you to use the app.

Editing this to bring it down more. There are only a few categories now to look at and historic stock pricing seems to either never stop loading, or just not pop up besides 24 hours. Editing again because I just put in a few orders and my account cash balance isn't updating after each order. So now I don't know what to have qued for market opening tomorrow, since I can't see what I've committed. This was never a problem before.

Since Wealthsimple Trade was merged into a "one-stop-shop", I have had nothing but problems with running the app. I will spend about two minutes browsing stocks and I get an "Something Went Wrong. Please close the app and try again." Error. I close the app, reopen it, and it does the same thing again. The new consolidated app is also way too crowded, I much prefer having it under the old "Trade" design where it was just my stock and crypto trading portfolio.

Really great app for Canadians that want to invest in Canadian stocks. I would really LOVE an option to see "total dividends earned from one stock or "total monthky dividends earned". However, unfortunately, right now they only display dividends in the acitivies and it is really congested there. It sucks that you cant view the price of stocks in real time unless you pay for premium but Yahoo finaces can do that for you for free.

Was a decent but not great app until recently. New updates have cause problems that have gone unfixed, mainly having to login everytime which requires getting an email code sent to you. Bad reviews and reddit post should have made them aware of this problem, and yet nothing has been done. WealthSimple is is a reasonably simple platform for executing stock trades. It doesn't have a lot of features (even with the "premium" upgrade), but it's mostly easy for beginners to use - it is perhaps best paired with other, more informative stock data apps. The following is not a review of the WealthSimple platform itself, but of the "WealthSimple Trade" app. ...The UI for entering stock trade orders is AWFUL. The moment you push the "Buy" or "Sell" buttons, the interface slows to a crawl, with a 1 to 5 second delay between pressing any button and the button taking effect - if the button press wasn't ignored outright. Not only does this slow down the process of placing a trade order, but it can lead to accidentally executing trades at the wrong volume or price (e.g. buying 112 instead of 12, selling at $1 instead of at $15, accidentally skipping the "Confirm" screen) unless you wait at least 7 to 10 seconds between EVERY BUTTON PRESS to confirm that the UI did not double-press or drop any of your inputs. Most Android phones have pop-up keyboard support as a standard OS feature, which many apps use to enter text and numbers into fields - why build a "keypad interface" that actively encourages input errors, in an app which handles actual financial transactions in real-time? "Calculator" apps have been around for a long time, and for the most part, they seem to have solved the "problem" of responsive numeric input. Perhaps the developers of the "WealthSimple Trade" app should study a few examples.
